old_wizard_intro.speaker: Old wizard
pages: Ah. A new face. You walked all the way up the hill, so you are either a student or lost.
Either way, you will want these. The four every wizard starts with: fireball, minor heal, thunderstrike, gust of wind. Four empty scrolls, and a grimoire with your name on it.
A spell is just an item until it is bound to a scroll. The ritual circle north of the quad does the binding: stand in the middle.
Fireball first. Everyone does fireball first. Come back when you have twelve of them and we will talk about the real one. Press G to open the grimoire.

old_wizard_again.speaker: Old wizard
pages: Back already? Here, another set. Burn through as many as you like; that is what a student is for.
The circle is north of the quad, by the scriptorium. Stand in the middle and it will open for you.

sign_gate.speaker: Sign
pages: The Collegium. Scriptorium and Library to the north, harbour to the east. Mind the fountain.

sign_scriptorium.speaker: Sign
pages: Scriptorium. The ritual circle outside is open to all students. Twelve points, one scroll, no refunds.

sign_library.speaker: Sign
pages: Great Library. Quiet, please. Also closed until later.

sign_harbour.speaker: Sign
pages: Harbour and boatyard. Blueprints wanted. Fishing permitted, catching not guaranteed.
